0022600042.text: The Clippers host the Oklahoma City Thunder at 2-8, with a 0-5 road record, a 2-8 mark over their last 10 games, and a 13th-place standing in the West. Oklahoma City arrives at 8-3, having won seven of its last 10 and sitting 6th in the West, with a 5-0 home record. The Clippers trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 108-101 loss in Oklahoma City on October 25, and they lost all three meetings in the 2025-26 season. The Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while Cam Christie is day-to-day with an ankle injury, and the Thunder are without Ajay Mitchell (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms), and Thomas Sorber (knee).
